notes: Two-bullet page and only one of them is a walkthrough. Bullet 1 holds both actions -- 'Speak to Rycharde, then trade him a Puffball' -- so it splits into a talk that opens the quest and a trade that closes it, both on the same NPC in the same spot, which the runtime draws as a single marker. Bullet 2 sits under a bare 'Note' heading and is an availability window, not a step: eight real hours after Way of the Cook before Rycharde will offer this at all. Nothing in the packets sees that clock, so it is flagged and gates nothing. The page never says where a Puffball comes from, so no obtain step is invented -- holding one is what makes the trade ready, and the header's Item Reqs already names it. Fame is blank in the header even though this is a Mhaura quest; the FLevel 2 is kept and the region left null rather than guessed from the category list.

notes: One bullet, one action: trade the Poetic Parchment to Mertaire. The unnumbered 'Note:' above it is the interesting part -- the quest never appears in the quest log until it is already complete, so the addon can never see it as active. That does not change the ladder but it does mean the single step is only ever reachable through the log's completed state, and it is flagged so a human can decide whether the quest is worth emitting at all. 'Return to Mertaire' is the page telling you that you already have the parchment from The Old Monument, which is the Previous quest; there is no obtain step here because the page gives none. Level 30 is a plain level gate with no job attached, so jobs stays empty.

steps.note: the parchment is carried over from The Old Monument; the quest does not show in the log until it is finished

notes: Two bullets, two steps, both on Karl at Port Jeuno (H-8): he states the offer, you trade a White Rock. The Wonder Magic Set key item he hands back is the header's Reward, so by the reward rule it is NOT recorded as evidence -- it proves the quest is over, not that the trade happened, and it is the very thing the outer Wonder Magic Set quest is collecting. That outer quest is the real trap here: 'Quest Reqs: The Wonder Magic Set quest active' is a prerequisite on a quest being OPEN, not completed, and prev has no way to say that. Putting it in prev would assert the wrong relation and could hide this quest from anyone mid-chain, so prev stays empty and the requirement is flagged and noted instead.

notes: The bullets are in the wrong order for a ladder and that is the whole judgement call. Bullet 1 says obtain three hides, bullet 2 says speak to Hanaa Punaa to BEGIN and trade her the three to END -- so the conversation that opens the quest is buried in bullet 2 and has to come first, because the runtime treats accepting the quest as step 1 being done. The order is written as talk, obtain, trade; the player may of course farm the hides before ever speaking to her. The obtain rung is kept rather than folded into the trade because it is genuinely observable -- holding three Black Tiger Hides is exactly what moves the mark back onto Hanaa Punaa -- and because the page states it as its own instruction. Steps 1 and 3 are the same NPC in the same spot, so this is one marker with a gap in the middle that the page really does put there. The item is Black Tiger Hide singular; the header's plural does not resolve. Nothing on the page says where the hides drop.

notes: The page has NO walkthrough at all -- the prepass flagged it no_walkthrough and there is no 'After the walkthrough' section either. Everything below comes from the header, which is unusually explicit for once: Heiji at Norg (I-7), ten Rusty Subligar, and a Description that states outright that he accepts them one at a time. That is enough for an honest two-rung ladder -- talk to open, then trade -- and it is better than emitting start-NPC only, but it is header-derived rather than read from a walkthrough, so the quest is medium and both steps are medium. The trade carries a count of ONE, not ten: one at a time is what he takes, so holding a single Rusty Subligar is genuinely ready-to-hand-in, and the ten-fold repeat is a loop nothing in the packets can count. No evidence anywhere -- the subligaria are consumed as they go in and the scroll is the reward.
